title: Buy 1 Premium/Traditional Pizza & Get 1 Premium/Traditional/Max/Value Pizza for $1 @ Domino's (Saturdays)
body:
Deal: Buy 1 Premium/Traditional Pizza & Get 1 Premium/Traditional/Max/Value Pizza for $1 @ Domino's (Saturdays)

[DoaAn] Checked and it said not valid for delivery orders.
[uAware] As someone who always growing up preferring domino's they've gone so far down hill that they're now below pizza hut. It's straight up inedible now, they barely use any ingredients on the pizza and the ingredients taste like they've been frozen for 3 years. They were never gourmet or anything but these days I feel like they're even worse than frozen pizza.
[Tanvry] They were pretty good when I had them in 2023, has it gone that bad now
[tubeidea] They're not inedible, but they're only marginally better than a frozen pizza, and frozen pizza sucks. At the prices they charge, they're dreaming.
[hellno] Agree. I guess if you're out and there is no other choice I'd have it but if I'm eating at home I'd rather get a pizza from the supermarket.
[tonyjzx] dominos are in a profit squeeze… you can see it, you can read about it
they are big enough to survive but the only thing they can pinch on is the ingredients quality
i think even this deal isnt good knowing you are getting two very subpar saucer sized pizzas
[tubeidea] Rather go to maccas, seems like maccas is everywhere these days, but at least they're better than dominos.
[wetsandwich] Very store-dependent I assume.
My local is very similar to covid-era, just more expensive. I don't think they really skimp on ingredients.
I don't think the pizzas are worth much, but its the same as a $2 cheeseburger or whatever from mcdonalds, it does what it says on the label - makes you fat and satisfied.
[tonyjzx] i dont do this any more
i used to eat a large trad pizza by myself and wash it down with 600ml coke or whatever and the sodium and animal fat intake is insane
like i'd just wait for monday and get $10 red rooster chook and its enough for my family, ie. trad nuclear, couple two kids etc.
[ATTS] Curious what is the ingredients cost like for their pizza
[tonyjzx] cant be anything substantial
dominos buys shit bulk from the factories… obviously
[tubeidea] Haven't had a satisfying dominos pizza since 2017
[gcheap] Tried it, it will swap to the more expensive pizza for the full price. So can't do a cheaper pizza and then pick up a premium for $1.
[gcheap] Hey man I don't usually eat this garbage.
[freoleo] Code doesn't work in WA, have to click through offers
[generalpayne] So did you find this deal on offers? Not showing for me on the website in WA.
[freoleo] Yeah, its in "western Australia vouchers" in the offers section on the WA website "Super Saturday"
I got it earlier, still shows for me
edit: 669579 is the code in the link
[w33w00] Remember: design your own is considered traditional. Up to three toppings, mozzarella cheese is already included.
[dexx] buy 1, get a second for $1. Can it also be buy 2 and get 2 more for $2? Or are 2 separate orders needed?
[iSmart] website's crashed, well done everyone… No pizza for anyone :(
